voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: A giant bell has been lost in a river for four centuries. Cast in fourteen eighty-four for Myanmar's Shwedagon Pagoda, it was said to be the largest bell ever made.
In sixteen oh eight, Portuguese mercenary Filipe de Brito seized it, to melt down for cannons.
Where the Yangon and Bago rivers meet, the vessel carrying it sank under the weight.
Divers have searched for decades. In twenty fourteen, a team claimed to have found it. The claim was never proven.
It may lie beneath deep mud. The bell has never been found.
